title: Delete or wire up the dead stage-editor mutation path (StageEditorNotifier, StageValidator, Protected/LimitExceeded exceptions)

evidence.quote: return 'Weekly stages require at least one day of week';

why: A repo-wide grep for `.addStage(`, `.updateStage(`, `.deleteStage(`, `.reorderStages(` finds callers only inside stage_providers.dart itself (the notifier calling its own repository) and stage_definition_repository_impl.dart/stage_definition_repository.dart (the definitions) — StageEditorNotifier's five mutation methods have zero external callers (stageEditorProvider's only other reference, in curriculum_settings_screen.dart, is a bare ref.invalidate). That makes StageEditorNotifier.addStage/updateStage/deleteStage/reorderStages/resetToDefaults (stage_providers.dart), the repository's addStage/updateStage/deleteStage/reorderStages (stage_definition_repository_impl.dart + .../repositories/stage_definition_repository.dart), all of StageValidator, and both ProtectedStageException/StageLimitExceededException dead: ~200 lines of validated, exception-typed, individually-tested code that no screen can currently reach. It also means the EH-5 raw-English-message design smell in these exceptions (and in ArgumentError(validationError)) has zero live blast radius today, but would need fixing the moment anyone wires a stage-editor UI to this path.
recommendation: Either delete the whole unreachable path (StageEditorNotifier's 5 methods, the repository's 4 corresponding methods, StageValidator, and the two exception classes) if the feature was superseded by the chazara wizard's applyWizardResult, or — if a stage-editor screen is actually planned — wire it up now and fix EH-5 (stable error codes, not raw strings) and SM-5 (state = AsyncLoading()/AsyncValue.guard around the mutation itself, not just the refetch) before shipping it.
acceptance_criteria: grep for `.addStage(`/`.updateStage(`/`.deleteStage(`/`.reorderStages(` on StageDefinitionRepository either returns a real UI caller, or the dead methods/files are removed.

If kept: StageEditorNotifier's mutation methods wrap the repository call itself in AsyncValue.guard with a preceding AsyncLoading, and the exceptions carry stable codes resolved via AppLocalizations at the presentation boundary.
Existing tests (stage_exceptions_test.dart, stage_definition_repository_impl_test.dart) still pass after whichever choice is made.
